# viettelcloud_db_instance (Resource)

Manage a Viettel Cloud DBaaS DB instance. A replacement destroys the data of the instance; consider lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }. Terraform cannot destroy an instance that the backend reports as ABNORMAL, unless its operational_status is FAILED: resolve it in the console, then run terraform state rm or wait for ACTIVE or ERROR.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "subnet_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "root_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "viettelcloud_db_instance" "example" {
  name          = "example-db"
  description   = "Orders database"
  database_type = "postgresql"
  db_version    = { version = "16" }
  region        = { name = "hn-1" }
  flavor        = { name = "db.small" }
  volume_type   = { name = "ssd" }
  disk_size     = 20
  solution      = "basic"
  subnet        = { id = var.subnet_id }
  root_password = var.root_password

  backup_policy = {
    enabled         = true
    backup_interval = "weekly"
    day_of_week     = "sunday"
    start_hour      = 2
    max_auto_backup = 7
  }

  # Replacing a DB instance destroys its data.
  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `database_type` (String) Database type: mysql, postgresql, mariadb, or redis. Changing it replaces the DB instance, which destroys its data. When a viettelcloud_db_backup with create_before_destroy references this instance, change name in the same apply, because the new instance is created before the old one is destroyed and names are unique in a project.
- `db_version` (Attributes) DB version selector for the database type and region. Changed criteria keep the current version when it still matches. Selecting a different version replaces the DB instance, which destroys its data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--db_version))
- `disk_size` (Number) Disk size in GB that creation requests. Refresh keeps this value; the provisioned size, which auto-increase can grow, is current_disk_size. After an import, set it to current_disk_size. Changing it replaces the DB instance, which destroys its data. When a viettelcloud_db_backup with create_before_destroy references this instance, change name in the same apply, because the new instance is created before the old one is destroyed and names are unique in a project.
- `flavor` (Attributes) Flavor selector in the region. Changed criteria keep the current flavor when it still matches. Selecting a different flavor replaces the DB instance, which destroys its data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--flavor))
- `name` (String) DB instance name, unique in the project. Changing it replaces the DB instance, which destroys its data. When a viettelcloud_db_backup with create_before_destroy references this instance, change name in the same apply, because the new instance is created before the old one is destroyed and names are unique in a project.
- `region` (Attributes) Region of the DB instance. Changing it replaces the DB instance, which destroys its data. When a viettelcloud_db_backup with create_before_destroy references this instance, change name in the same apply, because the new instance is created before the old one is destroyed and names are unique in a project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--region))
- `root_password` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Root password, sent only at creation and never stored in state. Changing it later has no effect and plans no change; change the password in the console.
- `solution` (String) Solution: basic or business. Changing it replaces the DB instance, which destroys its data. When a viettelcloud_db_backup with create_before_destroy references this instance, change name in the same apply, because the new instance is created before the old one is destroyed and names are unique in a project.
- `subnet` (Attributes) Existing subnet in a VPC of the same region. Changing it replaces the DB instance, which destroys its data. When a viettelcloud_db_backup with create_before_destroy references this instance, change name in the same apply, because the new instance is created before the old one is destroyed and names are unique in a project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnet))
- `volume_type` (Attributes) Volume type selector in the region. Changed criteria keep the current volume type when it still matches. Selecting a different volume type replaces the DB instance, which destroys its data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--volume_type))

### Optional

- `auto_increase_volume_size` (Attributes) Automatic disk increase. Omit it to keep the current setting. A new instance starts with it disabled, so enabled = true is accepted only on an existing instance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auto_increase_volume_size))
- `backup_policy` (Attributes) Automatic backup policy. Omit it to keep the current policy. A new instance has automatic backups disabled. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--backup_policy))
- `description` (String) Description. Omit it to keep the current value; set an empty string to clear it.
- `enable_public_access` (Boolean) Whether the instance has a public endpoint. Defaults to false at creation. Changing it replaces the DB instance, which destroys its data. When a viettelcloud_db_backup with create_before_destroy references this instance, change name in the same apply, because the new instance is created before the old one is destroyed and names are unique in a project.
- `keep_backup` (Boolean) Whether backups remain after the instance is deleted. Omit it to keep the current value. A new instance always starts with true, so false is accepted only on an existing instance.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_cidrs` (Set of String) CIDRs allowed to connect.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339).
- `current_disk_size` (Number) Disk size in GB that the backend has provisioned, including any automatic increase.
- `disk_full` (Boolean) Whether the disk is full.
- `enable_ssl` (Boolean) Whether SSL is enabled.
- `error_message` (String) Last error that the backend reported.
- `flavor_ram` (Number) RAM of the flavor in MB.
- `flavor_vcpus` (Number) vCPUs of the flavor.
- `id` (String) DB instance ID (UUID).
- `init_backup_id` (String) ID (UUID) of the backup that the instance was restored from, if any.
- `maintenance_config` (Attributes) Maintenance window that the backend assigns. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--maintenance_config))
- `operational_status` (String) Running operation, such as NOOP or DELETING.
- `port` (Number) Database port.
- `private_url` (String) Private endpoint host. Empty until the backend first syncs the instance.
- `project_id` (String) Owning project ID (UUID).
- `public_url` (String) Public endpoint host.
- `region_id` (String) Region ID (UUID).
- `status` (String) Instance status, such as ACTIVE.
- `subnet_cidr` (String) Subnet CIDR.
- `subnet_name` (String) Subnet name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC3339).
- `used_disk_size` (Number) Used disk space in MB.
- `volume_type_disk_type` (String) Disk type of the volume type: nvme, ssd, sas, or hdd.
- `vpc_id` (String) VPC ID (UUID) of the subnet.
- `vpc_name` (String) VPC name of the subnet.

<a id="nestedatt--auto_increase_volume_size"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auto_increase_volume_size`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the disk grows automatically. Required when auto_increase_volume_size is configured.
- `limit` (Number) Maximum disk size in GB, 20 to 3000 in steps of 10. Required when enabled is true; rejected when it is false.
- `threshold` (Number) Used-space percentage that triggers an increase, 50 to 95. Required when enabled is true; rejected when it is false.


<a id="nestedatt--backup_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `backup_policy`

Optional:

- `backup_interval` (String) daily or weekly. Required when enabled is true; rejected when it is false.
- `day_of_week` (String) Lowercase day name. Required when backup_interval is weekly; rejected otherwise.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether automatic backups run. Required when backup_policy is configured.
- `max_auto_backup` (Number) Automatic backups kept, 7 to 180. Required when enabled is true; rejected when it is false.
- `start_hour` (Number) Start hour, 0 to 23. Required when enabled is true; rejected when it is false.


<a id="nestedatt--maintenance_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `maintenance_config`

Read-Only:

- `day_of_week` (String) Lowercase day name, such as sunday.
- `start_hour` (Number) Start hour, 0 to 23.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import viettelcloud_db_instance.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001
```
